### The Japan side of 508.dev is going strong!

To celebrate the rising number of members and contributions, we got together for some beers earlier this April.

These happy fellows (top to bottom) Michael, Kevin, and Cas on the left. And Alfred, Masa, Robbin, and Sanath on the right, are seen here enjoying some well-earned beverages, on 508's tab 🙏

![Japan meetup](/japan-meet-1.jpg)

We discussed life in Japan, pets, and gaming expat life to maximize perks!

Much to my delight, I found the guys seated at a very chill [Portland style craft beer bar](https://www.google.com/search?q=PDX+beer+bar+harajuku&sca_esv=81978db0d0913d93&sxsrf=ANbL-n40mCUxCy4Q92690Yc4-YNnj1ppfA:1776073966012&ei=7rzcad0wh5S-vQ_BsMzhDA&biw=1693&bih=1060&ved=0ahUKEwjd39qOx-qTAxUHiq8BHUEYM8wQ4dUDCBE&uact=5&oq=PDX+beer+bar+harajuku&gs_&sclient=gws-wiz-serp) across the street from the Trunk Hotel in Harajuku. The original plan to have dinner at said Hotel fell through because of some loud DJ event.

Let's do it again soon, devs!
